signals.text: Revenue grew 48% a year over 3 years vs 54% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 56% vs revenue at 48%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 84 bps in 3 years (15.1% → 15.9%).
Working-capital days lengthened by 26 days in 3 years (107 → 133).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was -63% of reported profit: profits are not converting to cash, a red flag.
Free cash flow was negative in 5 of the last 5 years: capex is running ahead of cash generation.

guidance.statement: We are targeting about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business this year.
guidance.quote: We said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.

guidance.statement: We are targeting INR450 to INR500 crores of full-year revenue between OSAT and PCB businesses.
guidance.quote: we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time

guidance.statement: We commit to achieving twice the market growth rate for our revenue going forward.
guidance.quote: revenue growth, we have committed the 2x of the market growth.

guidance.statement: We are pretty confident that by the end of the financial year we will turn cash positive.
guidance.quote: by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.

guidance.statement: Commercial production and revenue booking from OSAT and PCB are set to start from Q3 FY27.
guidance.quote: our commercial production is set to start from the next quarter

guidance.statement: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on track to be operational by Q3 FY27.
guidance.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27

guidance.statement: Our first 3U satellite is expected to be ready to launch in the middle of next year.
guidance.quote: Our first 3U satellite is currently in the prototype development phase, and we expect it to be ready to launch in middle of next year

delivered.statement: Total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 40%.
EBITDA for the quarter was INR147.6 crores, translating into an EBITDA margin of 15.6%.
The company reported a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores.
Standalone EMS business grew 53% year-on-year from INR480 crores to INR639 crores.
Overseas entities revenue grew 327% from INR24 crores to INR102 crores.
Smart metering revenue declined 12% year-on-year to INR204 crores due to strategic working capital controls.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term margins and working capital, but confident on long-term growth and new initiatives.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the sub-optimal returns and persistent working capital issues in the smart metering business.
Concerns were raised regarding margin pressures and gross margin compression from rising component and PCB costs.
Analysts pressed management on negative operating cash flows and rising receivables in the metering segment.
Analysts asked why the consolidated effective tax rate was high at around 35%.

business.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited is an end-to-end electronics manufacturing services (EMS) player offering solutions from conceptualization to design, manufacturing, and lifecycle support across automotive, industrial, aerospace, defense, and smart metering sectors.

segments.name: EMS Business
segments.note: Core contract manufacturing of electronic assemblies and systems.

segments.name: GridCrest (Smart Metering)
segments.note: Smart meter manufacturing, installation, and software solutions.

segments.name: Kaynes Semicon & Kaynes Circuit
segments.note: New strategic verticals for OSAT packaging and PCB manufacturing.

guidance.statement: Rail business is expected to grow by around 20% to 25% this year.
guidance.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.

guidance.statement: PCB revenue is expected around INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores

guidance.statement: OSAT revenue is expected around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

guidance.statement: Goal is to steadily increase contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of total revenue.
guidance.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.

guidance.statement: OSAT order outlook has revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: In OSAT, the order outlook for both the current year and the medium term remains strong with revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.

delivered.statement: Consolidated total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.
EBITDA for FY26 was INR5,741 million with an EBITDA margin of 15.8%.
Profit after tax for FY26 came in at INR3,639 million, representing a PAT margin of 10%.
Q4 FY26 total revenue stood at INR12,426 million, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 26%.
Metering business contributed INR971 crores to the total revenue in FY26.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term execution and working capital, but confident in long-term growth, diversification, and new segments.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the vast variance and credibility of guidance given the heavy miss on top-line targets.
Analysts pressed management on why OCF remained heavily negative despite earlier neutral guidance.
Analysts repeatedly questioned ballooning receivables and delayed installations in the metering subsidiary.
Concern was raised regarding cash flow issues and whether working capital will erode future revenue growth.

guidance.statement: Management reiterates the $1 billion revenue guidance for fiscal '28.
guidance.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that

guidance.statement: The total capex for the OSAT business is INR3,200 crores.
guidance.quote: INR3,200 crores is the total capex for OSAT

guidance.statement: The total capex for the PC Board business is INR1,400 crores.
guidance.quote: INR1,400 crores is the total capex for PC Board.

guidance.statement: Expect at least INR1,500 crores from the OSAT business.
guidance.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.

guidance.statement: Expect about INR1,000 crores from the PC Board business.
guidance.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

guidance.statement: Expect net working capital around 70 to 85 days by March '26.
guidance.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days.

guidance.statement: Spend about another INR400-odd crores of capex in this year.
guidance.quote: So, you can take broadly in this year, maybe about another INR400-odd crores of capex will be spent.

delivered.statement: Total revenue for the 9-month period ended December '25 stood at INR23,837 million.
Operational EBITDA for the quarter was INR3,778 million, translating to a 15.9% margin.
Profit after tax came in at INR2,726 million, representing an 11.4% PAT margin.
The company has an order book of around INR90,000 million pending.

calls.tone: Confident in long-term demand and strategic road map despite near-term execution hiccups and order deferrals.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the gap between strong order inflows and actual revenue growth execution.
Scepticism regarding elevated receivable days and inventory build-up despite guidance to bring down NWC.
Questions raised on revenue contribution, long-term sustainability, and debtor cycle of the metering business.

guidance.statement: Balance requirement for OSAT INR10.3 billion will be funded through QIP, internal accruals, and transitory debt.
guidance.quote: First balance requirement for OSAT INR10.3 billion will be funded through QIP and spent amount of about 3.8 billion and balance internal accruals capex spread over five years and some transitory debt.

guidance.statement: PCB current plan includes capex of 14 billion for which balance requirement is 3.2 billion.
guidance.quote: Second thing is that with regard to PCB, the current plan includes only capex of 14 billion for which the balance requirement is 3.2 billion and up central government subsidy of about 3 billion.

delivered.statement: Kaynes reported FY25 revenues of 27.2 billion, 51% year-on-year increase.
H2 FY25 net margin is 9% with revenues of INR5,327 million and PAT of INR489 million.
Consolidated net working capital cycle inventory days plus receivable minus payable days was 87 days in FY25.

calls.tone: management is defensive on disclosures but confident on long-term growth and structural strength

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned errors and inconsistencies in notes to accounts and reporting.
Analysts raised concerns over rising cash conversion cycle and negative operating cash flows.
Analysts highlighted elevated capex spending and increasing contingent liabilities.
Analysts questioned aged receivables, discounting costs, and provisioning impact on margins.
